title: Sophia: A Scalable Stochastic Second-order Optimizer for Language Model Pre-training

paper.title: Sophia: A Scalable Stochastic Second-order Optimizer for Language Model Pre-training
paper.authors: Hong Liu, Zhiyuan Li, David Hall, Percy Liang, Tengyu Ma
paper.summary: Uses a cheap diagonal Hessian estimate to scale momentum, and clips each coordinate step, which speeds up language model pretraining.
